text.notes:
* Upon dismount, Skaarl will spawn at Kled's location and path towards the nearest brush outside of a minimum radius.
* Upon entering brush, Skaarl becomes invisible to both teams. Enemy Sweeper Drones grant obscured vision of Skaarl.
* The time it takes Kled to remount is not dependent on his proximity to Skaarl; Kled will remount even if Skaarl does not reach him in time.
* Once spawned, Skaarl gains bonus movement speed. If Skaarl's path is blocked, she additionally becomes ghosted.
** Skaarl sometimes does not gain bonus movement speed.
* Skaarl will appear on the map as a minion despite being untargetable and invulnerable.
